prompt: Style: bold hand-drawn illustration: confident black ink outlines with lively line weight, rich saturated watercolour and gouache colour (vermilion red, deep teal, saffron yellow, cobalt blue, emerald green, warm coral, a touch of violet), vivid and joyful, crisp clean edges, painterly texture inside shapes, no cast shadow, no background scene unless asked, no photographic elements. Every object has a clear dark ink outline.
